policy: Record only observations actually performed on the exact revision and stated OS, including failed checks. Bundling, typechecks and React Native Web are not device verification.

checks.procedure: Open sheet at both snap points; rotate; confirm title and footer avoid notch and home indicator.
Focus first/last input, enter Japanese, scroll and dismiss keyboard; verify focused field and submit remain reachable, no double inset.
Set OS accessibility text size to largest, reopen app; verify full labels wrap and controls remain reachable.
Drag handle between 0.5 and 0.9, scroll inner content, dismiss and reopen five times; ensure no invisible input-blocking modal.
Enable VoiceOver/TalkBack; verify names, modal focus, field labels and close action.
